acceptedAnswer.text: Raven Platforms Inc. is a Toronto-based digital product studio that designs and builds custom websites, web applications, mobile apps, e-commerce stores, and automation systems for businesses across North America and the Caribbean.
Raven Platforms Inc. is registered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and serves clients across Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.

mainEntity.name: What services does Raven Platforms offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Services include custom websites, web apps and SaaS platforms, e-commerce, iOS and Android mobile apps, SEO and performance optimization, branding and design, automation and integrations, and ongoing maintenance and support.

mainEntity.name: How do I contact Raven Platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can reach Raven Platforms at contact@onraven.ca or through the contact form on this website. The team typically replies within one business day.

mainEntity.name: Who does Raven Platforms work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Raven Platforms works with ambitious businesses across industries including transportation, real estate, hospitality, automotive, healthcare, and technology startups.

mainEntity.name: Does Raven Platforms take on audits, DevOps, or freelance projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Alongside full product builds, Raven Platforms takes on technical audits, DevOps and cloud infrastructure work, and focused freelance or fractional engagements - in Toronto or fully remote.
